title: Make a dataset from a dictionary
summary: A Dataset holds rows with named columns. from_dict creates a dataset from equally sized lists, one list per column.
introduction: A Dataset holds rows with named columns. from_dict creates a dataset from equally sized lists, one list per column. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Explain make a dataset from a dictionary
Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: A Dataset holds rows with named columns. from_dict creates a dataset from equally sized lists, one list per column.

blocks.code:
from datasets import Dataset
data = Dataset.from_dict({"text": ["moon glows", "sun shines", "stars twinkle"], "length": [2, 2, 2]})
print(data.num_rows, data.column_names)
blocks.title: Make a dataset from a dictionary

blocks.text: The result shows three rows and the text and length columns. The first text and first length form one record.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
